name: Last ring opens and the ball escapes
looks: The final ring, now just a single thin arc, opens fully as the ball sails through and off into open space; the moment it clears, a short bold word lands alone on the dark field, settled and still, closing the countdown on a clean payoff beat.
build: Final ring's gap widens to the point the arc reads as nearly a full circle breaking open; the ball's exit trajectory is a straight tween continuing past the frame edge with a light trailing glow. The payoff word fades/rises in (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~300ms) the instant the ball clears, timed to the music's resolving beat.
sound: The highest, brightest note of the ascending run on the final pass, then a clean resolving chord under the payoff word.
prompt: On the last step of a countdown or unlock sequence, let the final barrier open fully and the subject sail cleanly through and offscreen; the instant it clears, land one short word alone on the field to name the payoff, timed to the music's resolving beat.
